newsitem.title: USA: Photocomm says deal sours with ACX.
newsitem.headline: Photocomm says deal sours with ACX.

text.p: Photocomm Inc said Thursday it has been unable to reach an agreement with ACX Technologies Inc, under which ACX would have purchased a stake in the company.
Photocomm said it believed ACX was unresponsive to its request for more information on ACX's role as a potential majority stockholder.
Under a tentative agreement reached in August, ACX was to have bought two million new-issue shares in Photocomm.

The proposed ACX stock purchase, along with a previously announced intention to acquire 6.6 million Photocomm shares from New World Power Corp, would have left ACX with a 51 percent majority interest in Photocomm.

"As the potential majority shareholder, ACX could significantly affect the company's future plans and strategies and, in our opinion, has been unresponsive to request for specific information regarding these issues," Photocomm President and Chief Executive Robert Kauffman said in a statement.
Kauffman said the Photocomm board has decided that the ACX proposal was inadequate, "at least pending additional clarification."
ACX, which is based in Colorado, could not be immediately reached for comment.
Photocomm manufactures and markets wireless solar electric power systems.
